description: dod.mark: one item's state, evidence-bound. A met item names its evidence (kind and ref — verify_run names a run, manual the person's reference), and the store's pairing backstop decides whose mark a kind of evidence is (a verify_run mark is the engine's, a manual mark the person's; the mismatch refuses before SQL). The actor is the connection's person, never a param. The answer is the item as it now stands.
